basic_info.description: This elegant, six-bedroom Edwardian home - renovated from the ground up in 2007 with seismic, electrical, plumbing, and heating upgrades - blends classic architecture with modern function. Designed for entertaining, the main level features oak floors, beveled glass doors, formal living and dining rooms, and a walk-out deck.  An open-layout, European-inspired kitchen with stone counters and a premium appliance suite connects to the glass-ceilinged family room and breakfast area - all overlooking the verdant patio and garden. On the second level, the primary suite includes a fireplace, walk-in closet, en-suite bath with dual vanities, rain shower, and soaking tub. Two guest bedrooms share a skylit hall bath, while a laundry center adds convenience. The third level offers a light-filled office, spacious media/play room, sixth bedroom, and a skylit full bath. The lower level includes two bedrooms sharing a hall bath, temperature-controlled wine cellar, two-car garage, and storage. Additional amenities include whole-home tech systems, dual water heaters, and irrigation. Located on a coveted block between Pacific Heights and Presidio Heights, with easy access to Alta Plaza, the Presidio, and Fillmore/Sacramento Street shops and dining, 3176 Clay offers the best of city living.
